title: Payments Schedule Extract — Extra-Guest Fee Share Returned by Payment Plan
content:
# Payments schedule extract — share of the extra-guest fee returned

**Rule.** How much of the extra-guest fee of a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category is returned depends on how the stay is paid: on a stay paid in monthly installments whose collections have begun, the extra-guest fee was collected in full up front, so the share returned is the extra-guest-refundable nights divided by the stay's nights; on a pay-part-now stay whose balance has not been collected, the share returned is the extra-guest-refundable nights divided by the stay's nights, times the deposit percentage of the stay's policy; on any other stay the share returned is the nightly amount refunded on the same cancellation divided by the stay's nightly subtotal.

Extra-guest-refundable nights are the nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date, less the nights the extra-guest-fee refund holds back for notice. A stay's collections have begun once its ledger shows any collection; its balance has been collected once the ledger shows installment 2 collected.

Deposit percentage of each policy: Flexible 50.00%, Moderate 50.00%, Limited 50.00%, Firm 50.00%; Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term 0.00%, where pay-part-now is not offered.

## Input — judgement — output (hypothetical stays)

1. *Monthly plan, 45 nights, installment 1 collected, 12 extra-guest-refundable nights* — collections have begun — share 12 divided by 45, about 0.2667.
2. *Monthly plan, no collection on the ledger yet, nightly subtotal 4,500.00, guest-cancellation nightly refund 0.00* — collections have not begun, so the nightly-refund share applies — share 0.
3. *Pay-part-now on Firm, balance not collected, 14 nights, 7 extra-guest-refundable nights* — share 7 divided by 14, times 50.00%, that is 0.25.
4. *Paid in full, nightly subtotal 900.00, guest-cancellation nightly refund 450.00* — share 0.50.
